# setup

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# --- Define patient and Seurat object ---
sample <- "pt3385"
seurat <- "pt3385_SeuObj_scTransform_RegrOut_mt_feat_mkrs_Tcells_W_clonotypes.rds"
# --- Define paths ---
datapath <- "/mnt/bioinfnas/immuno/eprieto/analyses/sturcotte/patients"
folder_data <- "deconv"
datapath_seurat <- "/mnt/petasan_immuno/raw_data/itag/collabs/sturcotte/scSeq/deconv/seurat"
datapath_cellranger <- "/mnt/petasan_immuno/raw_data/itag/collabs/sturcotte/scSeq/deconv/cellranger"
datapath_raw_data <- "/mnt/petasan_immuno/raw_data/itag/collabs/sturcotte/scSeq/deconv/raw_data"
# --- Load libraries and custom functions ---
set.seed(123)
source("~/sturcotte/scripts/setup-m1.R")
```

# load

VDJ data loading with djvdj: https://rnabioco.github.io/djvdj/

```{r}
# --- Load the Seurat object ---
obj <- readRDS(file.path(datapath_seurat, sample, seurat))
obj@meta.data$sample_id <- recode(obj@meta.data$sample_id,
                                  "PeptidePool" = "Pept_pool")
obj@meta.data$barcode <- sub("^.*_", "", rownames(obj@meta.data))
meta <- obj@meta.data
# --- Load V(D)J data from Cell Ranger outputs ---
vdj_dirs <- list.dirs(file.path(datapath_cellranger, sample),
                      recursive = FALSE,
                      full.names = TRUE)
vdj_dirs <- setNames(vdj_dirs, basename(vdj_dirs))
vdj_meta <- lapply(names(vdj_dirs),
                   function(sample_id) {
                     cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$sample_id == sample_id]
                     if (length(cells) == 0L) {
                       warning("No cells for this sample: ", sample_id)
                       return(NULL)
                       }
                     so <- subset(obj, cells = cells)
                     so <- RenameCells(so,
                                       new.names = as.character(meta[colnames(so), "barcode"]))
                     meta_cols <- colnames(so@meta.data)
                     so <- import_vdj(so,
                                      vdj_dir = vdj_dirs[[sample_id]])
                     vdj_cols <- setdiff(colnames(so@meta.data), meta_cols)
                     data.frame(sample_id = sample_id,
                                barcode = rownames(so@meta.data),
                                so@meta.data[, vdj_cols, drop = FALSE],
                                check.names = FALSE)
                     }
                   )
vdj_meta <- bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), vdj_meta))
if (anyDuplicated(vdj_meta[, c("sample_id", "barcode")])) {
  stop("Duplicated sample_id/barcode combinations in VDJ metadata.")
}
vdj_cols <- setdiff(colnames(vdj_meta),
                    c("sample_id", "barcode"))
if (length(vdj_cols) == 0L) {
  stop("import_vdj() did not generate new metadata columns.")
}
meta <- meta %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
  left_join(vdj_meta,
            by = c("sample_id", "barcode")) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("cell_id")
obj <- AddMetaData(obj,
                   metadata = meta[, vdj_cols, drop = FALSE])
obj@meta.data$sample_id <- factor(
  obj@meta.data$sample_id,
  levels = c(
    "Unpulsed",
    "CD3CD28",
    "Pept_pool",
    paste0("R", sort(as.numeric(sub("^R", "", grep("^R[0-9]+$", unique(obj@meta.data$sample_id), value = TRUE)))))
  )
)
stopifnot(identical(rownames(obj@meta.data), colnames(obj)))
```

# qc

Overview.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
obj@meta.data$logreads <- log1p(obj@meta.data$nCount_RNA)
# --- Recover SCT corrected counts ---
sct_counts <- expm1(
  SeuratObject::LayerData(
    obj,
    assay = "SCT",
    layer = "data"
  )
)
total_counts <- Matrix::colSums(sct_counts)
percentage_sct <- function(pattern) {
  genes <- grep(pattern,
                rownames(sct_counts),
                value = TRUE)
  if (length(genes) == 0L) {
    warning("No genes found for pattern: ", pattern)
    return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(sct_counts)))
  }
  100 * Matrix::colSums(
    sct_counts[genes, , drop = FALSE]
  ) / total_counts
}
# --- Mito and ribo genes ---
obj@meta.data$percent.mt <- percentage_sct("^MT-")
obj@meta.data$percent.rpl <- percentage_sct("^RPL")
obj@meta.data$percent.rps <- percentage_sct("^RPS")
obj@meta.data$percent.rpa <- percentage_sct("^RPS|^RPL")
# --- TCR genes ---
obj@meta.data$TRAV.avg <- percentage_sct("^TRAV")
obj@meta.data$TRAJ.avg <- percentage_sct("^TRAJ")
obj@meta.data$TRBV.avg <- percentage_sct("^TRBV")
obj@meta.data$TRBJ.avg <- percentage_sct("^TRBJ")
obj@meta.data$TRGV.avg <- percentage_sct("^TRGV")
obj@meta.data$TRDV.avg <- percentage_sct("^TRDV")
md <- obj@meta.data
rm(sct_counts, total_counts, percentage_sct)
```

Classification of cells according to TCR detection status (TCR-positive vs. TCR-negative).

```{r}
obj$tag.tcr <- ifelse(obj@meta.data$paired %in% TRUE, "yes", "no")
```

Comparison of quality-control metrics between TCR-positive and TCR-negative cells.

```{r}
md <- obj@meta.data
n1 <- rownames(md)[md$tag.tcr == "yes"]
n2 <- rownames(md)[md$tag.tcr == "no"]
metrics <- c("percent.mt", "percent.rpa", "TRAV.avg", "TRBV.avg")
# --- Cells with TCR ---
qc_tcr <- list()
for (i in metrics) {
  plot_i <- ggplot(
    md[n1, , drop = FALSE],
    aes(x = sample_id, y = .data[[i]], fill = sample_id)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.alpha = 0.2,
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
    labs(
      y = i
    ) +
    theme_ic +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  if (i == "percent.mt") {
    plot_i <- plot_i +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 10,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.3
      )
  }
  qc_tcr[[i]] <- plot_i
}
# --- Cells without TCR ---
qc_no_tcr <- list()
for (i in metrics) {
  plot_i <- ggplot(
    md[n2, , drop = FALSE],
    aes(x = sample_id, y = .data[[i]], fill = sample_id)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.alpha = 0.2,
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
    labs(
      y = i
    ) +
    theme_ic +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  if (i == "percent.mt") {
    plot_i <- plot_i +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 10,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.3
      )
  }
  qc_no_tcr[[i]] <- plot_i
}
# --- Plots ---
plots_list[["IC01_qc_tcr"]] <- wrap_plots(qc_tcr, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Cells with TCR")
plots_list[["IC01_qc_no_tcr"]] <- wrap_plots(qc_no_tcr, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Cells without TCR")
print(plots_list[["IC01_qc_tcr"]])
print(plots_list[["IC01_qc_no_tcr"]])
rm(i, metrics, plot_i, qc_tcr, qc_no_tcr)
```

Assessment of mitochondrial and ribosomal RNA filtering thresholds.

```{r}
md <- obj@meta.data
n1 <- rownames(md)[md$tag.tcr == "yes"]
n2 <- rownames(md)[md$tag.tcr == "no"]
metrics <- c("percent.mt", "percent.rpl", "percent.rps", "percent.rpa")
# --- Cells with TCR ---
qc_curves_tcr <- list()
for (i in metrics) {
  thresholds <- seq(0, 70, by = 1)
  results <- data.frame(
    threshold = numeric(),
    passing_cells = numeric(),
    sample_id = character()
  )
  for (j in levels(md$sample_id)) {
    sample_data <- md[n1, , drop = FALSE]
    sample_data <- sample_data[sample_data$sample_id == j, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(sample_data) == 0) next
    for (k in thresholds) {
      percent_passing <- mean(sample_data[[i]] <= k, na.rm = TRUE)
      results <- rbind(
        results,
        data.frame(
          threshold = k,
          passing_cells = percent_passing,
          sample_id = j
        )
      )
    }
  }
  results$sample_id <- factor(
    results$sample_id,
    levels = levels(md$sample_id)
  )
  plot_i <- ggplot(
    results,
    aes(x = threshold, y = passing_cells, color = sample_id)
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("max_", i),
      y = "Fraction passing filter",
      color = "Sample"
    ) +
    theme_ic
  if (i == "percent.mt") {
    plot_i <- plot_i +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = 10,
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.3,
        color = "black"
      )
  }
  qc_curves_tcr[[i]] <- plot_i
}
# --- Cells without TCR ---
qc_curves_no_tcr <- list()
for (i in metrics) {
  thresholds <- seq(0, 70, by = 1)
  results <- data.frame(
    threshold = numeric(),
    passing_cells = numeric(),
    sample_id = character()
  )
  for (j in levels(md$sample_id)) {
    sample_data <- md[n2, , drop = FALSE]
    sample_data <- sample_data[sample_data$sample_id == j, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(sample_data) == 0) next
    for (k in thresholds) {
      percent_passing <- mean(sample_data[[i]] <= k, na.rm = TRUE)
      results <- rbind(
        results,
        data.frame(
          threshold = k,
          passing_cells = percent_passing,
          sample_id = j
        )
      )
    }
  }
  results$sample_id <- factor(
    results$sample_id,
    levels = levels(md$sample_id)
  )
  plot_i <- ggplot(
    results,
    aes(x = threshold, y = passing_cells, color = sample_id)
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("max_", i),
      y = "Fraction passing filter",
      color = "Sample"
    ) +
    theme_ic
  if (i == "percent.mt") {
    plot_i <- plot_i +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = 10,
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.3,
        color = "black"
      )
  }
  qc_curves_no_tcr[[i]] <- plot_i
}
# --- Plots ---
plots_list[["IC02_qc_mt_filt_tcr"]] <- wrap_plots(qc_curves_tcr, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Cells with TCR")
plots_list[["IC02_qc_mt_filt_no_tcr"]] <- wrap_plots(qc_curves_no_tcr, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Cells without TCR")
print(plots_list[["IC02_qc_mt_filt_tcr"]])
print(plots_list[["IC02_qc_mt_filt_no_tcr"]])
rm(
  md, n1, n2, i, j, k, metrics, thresholds, results, sample_data, percent_passing,
  plot_i, qc_curves_tcr, qc_curves_no_tcr
)
```

Stratification of cells according to mitochondrial RNA content.

```{r}
obj$tag.mt <- case_when(
  obj$percent.mt > 20 ~ "elim_mt",
  obj$percent.mt >= 15 & obj$percent.mt <= 20 ~ "high_mt",
  obj$percent.mt >= 10 & obj$percent.mt < 15 ~ "int_mt",
  obj$percent.mt < 10 ~ "low_mt"
)
obj$tag.mt <- factor(obj$tag.mt, levels = c("elim_mt", "low_mt", "int_mt", "high_mt"))
# --- Summary table ---
mitochondrial_category_summary <- as.data.frame(
  table(
    mitochondrial_category = obj$tag.mt,
    sample_id = obj$sample_id
  )
)
print(mitochondrial_category_summary)
tables_list$qc[["mitochondrial_category_summary"]] <- mitochondrial_category_summary
```

Evaluation of associations between mitochondrial/ribosomal RNA content and TCR detection.

```{r}
md <- obj@meta.data
md$tag.tcr_label <- ifelse(

md$tag.tcr_label <- factor(

mito_plots_filter <- ggplot(
```

# doublets

Add the missing RNA counts layer to the Seurat object.

```{r}
base_path <- file.path(datapath_cellranger, sample)
samples <- unique(obj$sample_id)
sample_map <- list(
  "CD3CD28"   = "CD3CD28",
  "Pept_pool" = "PeptidePool",
  "R6"        = "R6",
  "R8"        = "R8",
  "Unpulsed"  = "Unpulsed"
)
count_list <- lapply(names(sample_map), function(folder) {
  path <- file.path(base_path, folder, "sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
  mat <- Read10X(path)
  prefix <- sample_map[[folder]]
  colnames(mat) <- paste0(prefix, "_", colnames(mat))
  mat
})
combined_counts <- do.call(cbind, count_list)
# --- Integrate in Seurat ---
cells_in_seurat <- colnames(obj)
common_cells <- intersect(cells_in_seurat, colnames(combined_counts))
obj[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(
  counts = combined_counts[, common_cells]
)
```

Run scDblFinder.

<https://github.com/plger/scDblFinder?tab=readme-ov-file>
<https://plger.github.io/scDblFinder/articles/scDblFinder.html>

```{r, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
# --- Transform Seurat to SCE ---
sce_obj <- as.SingleCellExperiment(obj, assay = "RNA")
colData(sce_obj)$sample_id <- obj$sample_id
sce_obj <- scDblFinder(
  sce_obj,
  samples = "sample_id",
  clusters = FALSE,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(RNGseed = 123)
)
# --- Return to Seurat ---
obj$scDblFinder.score <- sce_obj$scDblFinder.score
obj$scDblFinder.class <- sce_obj$scDblFinder.class
table(obj$scDblFinder.class)
rm(sce_obj)

# --- Association between doublet scores and logreads ---
doublet_plots <- ggplot(
  obj@meta.data,
  aes(x = logreads, y = scDblFinder.score, color = scDblFinder.class)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~sample_id) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "doublet" = "#FF5A1F",
      "singlet" = "#355070"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Doublets",
    x = "logreads",
    y = "scDblFinder score",
    color = "scDblFinder class"
  ) +
  theme_ic
plots_list[["IC04_qc_doublets"]] <- doublet_plots
plots_list[["IC04_qc_doublets"]]
rm(doublet_plots)

# --- Projected in the UMAP ---
g <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "scDblFinder.class", split.by = "scDblFinder.class", pt.size = 0.15, cols = c("doublet" = "#FF5A1F",  "singlet" = "#355070")) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + ggtitle("scDblFinder class")
plots_list[["IC04_qc_doublets_umap"]] <- g
plots_list[["IC04_qc_doublets_umap"]]
rm(g)
```

# mixcr

In our analyses, Cell Ranger failed to recover TCR sequences from a subset of highly activated T cells exhibiting elevated TCR transcript abundance. We suspect that their unusually high transcript counts led to their classification as putative doublets and subsequent exclusion from the TCR assignments.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# --- Load MiXCR V(D)J annotations ---
mixcr_dirs <- list.dirs(file.path(datapath_raw_data, sample),
                      recursive = FALSE,
                      full.names = TRUE)
mixcr_dirs <- setNames(mixcr_dirs, basename(mixcr_dirs))
mixcr_data <- list()
for (i in mixcr_dirs) {
  f <- file.path(i, "imgt", paste0("imgt_result.", basename(i), ".cell_alleles_filtered.tsv"))
  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    message("Skipping ", basename(i), ": file not found")
    next
  }
  mixcr_data[[basename(i)]] <- fread(f) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(cellGroup != "contamination") %>%
    select(tagValueCELL, bestVHit, bestDHit, bestJHit, aaSeqCDR3, topChains) %>%
    mutate(
      chain_rank = case_when(
        topChains == "TRA" ~ 1L,
        topChains == "TRB" ~ 2L,
        TRUE ~ 3L
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      tagValueCELL,
      chain_rank,
      aaSeqCDR3,
      bestVHit,
      bestJHit,
      bestDHit
    ) %>%
    group_by(tagValueCELL) %>%
    summarise(
      bestVHit = paste(bestVHit, collapse = ";"),
      bestJHit = paste(bestJHit, collapse = ";"),
      aaSeqCDR3 = paste(aaSeqCDR3, collapse = ";"),
      topChains = paste(topChains, collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    setNames(c("barcode", paste0(c("v_gene", "j_gene", "cdr3", "chains"), "_mixcr"))) %>%
    filter(
      if_any(
        c(v_gene_mixcr, j_gene_mixcr, cdr3_mixcr, chains_mixcr),
        ~ . != "" & !is.na(.)
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(sample_id = basename(i),
           barcode = paste0(barcode, "-1")
           )
}
mixcr <- bind_rows(mixcr_data) %>% as.data.frame()
# --- Integrate MiXCR annotations into cell metadata ---
meta <- obj@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(".rownames") %>%
  left_join(mixcr, by = c("barcode", "sample_id")) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(".rownames") %>%
  mutate(
    tag.tcr_mixcr = if_else(
      is.na(chains_mixcr) | chains_mixcr == "",
      "no",
      "yes"
    )
  )
# --- Combine Cell Ranger and MiXCR TCR assignments, prioritizing MiXCR ---
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    v_gene_combi = coalesce(na_if(v_gene_mixcr, ""), na_if(v_gene, "")),
    j_gene_combi = coalesce(na_if(j_gene_mixcr, ""), na_if(j_gene, "")),
    cdr3_combi = coalesce(na_if(cdr3_mixcr, ""), na_if(cdr3, "")),
    chains_combi = coalesce(na_if(chains_mixcr, ""), na_if(chains, "")),
    tag.tcr_combi = if_else(
      is.na(chains_combi) | chains_combi == "",
      "no",
      "yes"
    )
  )
table(meta$tag.tcr, meta$sample_id)
table(meta$tag.tcr_mixcr, meta$sample_id)
table(meta$tag.tcr_combi, meta$sample_id)
# --- Visualize TCR recovery improvements with MiXCR ---
plot_data <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, tag.tcr, tag.tcr_mixcr, tag.tcr_combi) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -sample_id,
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "TCR"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = c("tag.tcr", "tag.tcr_mixcr", "tag.tcr_combi"),
      labels = c("Cell Ranger", "MiXCR", "Cell Ranger + MiXCR")
    ),
    TCR = factor(TCR, levels = c("no", "yes"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(sample_id, method, TCR, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id, method) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
plot_tcr <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(method, percentage, fill = TCR)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~sample_id, ncol = n_distinct(plot_data$sample_id)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("no" = "#355070", "yes" = "#00B8A9")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cells (%)", fill = "TCR detected") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "plain")
  )
plots_list[["IC05_cellranger_mixcr"]] <- plot_tcr
print(plots_list[["IC05_cellranger_mixcr"]])
# --- Update the Seurat object with the combined TCR annotations ---
obj@meta.data <- meta
```

Internal control: Visual quality control of TCR recovery.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
g1 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "tag.tcr", pt.size = 0.1, cols = c("yes" = "#00B8A9",  "no" = "#355070")) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + ggtitle("Cell Ranger")
g2 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "tag.tcr_mixcr", pt.size = 0.1, cols = c("yes" = "#00B8A9",  "no" = "#355070")) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + ggtitle("MiXCR")
g3 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "tag.tcr_combi", pt.size = 0.15, cols = c("yes" = "#00B8A9",  "no" = "#355070")) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + ggtitle("Cell Ranger + MiXCR")
plots_list[["IC05_cellranger_mixcr_umap"]] <- wrap_plots(g1, g2, g3, ncol = 3)
print(plots_list[["IC05_cellranger_mixcr_umap"]])
rm(g1, g2, g3)
```

Assign unique TCR IDs to study-wide clonotypes.

```{r}
# --- Define clonotypes consistently across samples ---
clone_fields <- c("v_gene_combi", "j_gene_combi", "cdr3_combi")
clone_meta <- obj[[]][, clone_fields, drop = FALSE]
clone_meta[] <- lapply(clone_meta, function(x) trimws(as.character(x)))
non_empty <- complete.cases(clone_meta) &
  apply(clone_meta, 1, function(x) all(!x %in% c("", "NA", "None")))
paired <- grepl("TRA", obj$chains_mixcr) & grepl("TRB", obj$chains_mixcr)
valid_clone <- non_empty & paired
obj$CloneID <- ifelse(
  valid_clone,
  do.call(paste, c(clone_meta, sep = "__")),
  NA_character_
)
# --- Assign unique, study-wide TCR_IDs to clonotypes ---
tcr_key <- obj[[]] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(CloneID)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(CloneID) |>
  dplyr::arrange(CloneID) |>
  dplyr::mutate(TCR_ID = paste0("TCR.", dplyr::row_number()))
obj$TCR_ID <- tcr_key$TCR_ID[match(obj$CloneID, tcr_key$CloneID)]
# --- Validate clonotype-to-TCR_ID assignments ---
table(obj$chains_mixcr, has_TCR_ID = !is.na(obj$TCR_ID), useNA = "ifany")
cat("Unique paired clonotypes:", nrow(tcr_key), "\n")
```

# annotations

Cell-type annotations were further refined using scGate:
<https://github.com/carmonalab/scGate>

```{r, warning=FALSE}
scGate_models_DB <- get_scGateDB()
models.pbmc <- scGate_models_DB$human$PBMC
obj <- scGate(obj, assay = "SCT", model = models.pbmc)
obj$scGate_multi <- ifelse(is.na(obj$scGate_multi), "unknown", obj$scGate_multi)
table(obj$scGate_multi)
rm(scGate_models_DB, models.pbmc)
```

# filtering

Only T cells were retained. Cells without a recovered TCR assignment following Cell Ranger and MiXCR integration, as well as predicted doublets, were excluded before MAGIC imputation and subsequent CD4/CD8 classification.

```{r}
obj <- subset(obj, scDblFinder.class == "singlet" & tag.tcr_combi == "yes" & scGate_multi %in% c("CD4T", "CD8T", "unknown"))
table(obj$sample_id)
```

Following cell filtering, TCR and BCR genes were excluded to minimize receptor-driven clustering. The data were then normalized using SCTransform, and dimensionality reduction and UMAP embeddings were recalculated.

```{r}
# --- Exclude TCR and BCR genes from downstream analysis ---
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "SCT"
vf <- VariableFeatures(obj)
vf <- vf[!grepl("^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^IG[HKL][VDJ]", vf)]
VariableFeatures(obj) <- vf
# --- Perform SCTransform normalization and dimensionality reduction ---
obj <- SCTransform(obj, assay = "RNA")
obj <- RunPCA(obj)
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:20)
obj <- FindClusters(obj)
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:20, n.neighbors = 50, min.dist = 0.3)
# --- Visualize the updated UMAP embeddings ---
g1 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "sample_id", pt.size = 0.1) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + ggtitle("Filtered_sample_id")
g2 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "scGate_multi", pt.size = 0.1) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + ggtitle("Filtered_scGate_multi")
plots_list[["IC06_filtered_umap"]] <- g1 | g2
print(plots_list[["IC06_filtered_umap"]])
```

# magic

To reduce gene expression sparsity and improve the detection of transcriptional signals, expression data were imputed using MAGIC: <https://github.com/krishnaswamylab/MAGIC>
The Python package `magic-impute` was installed in a dedicated virtual environment and accessed from R through `reticulate`.
MAGIC-imputed expression values were integrated into the Seurat object for downstream analyses and visualization.

```{r, message=FALSE}
# --- Perform MAGIC imputation and integrate imputed expression values ---
genes_magic <- c(
  "CD4", "CD8A", "CD8B", "PDCD1", "ENTPD1", "CXCL13",
  "CD69", "TNFRSF9", "ICOS", "TNFRSF4",
  "NR4A1", "FOS", "JUNB", "EGR1", "NFKBIA",
  "IFNG", "CD38", "HLA-DRA",
  "IL2RA", "CD40LG"
)
sct_data <- SeuratObject::LayerData(obj, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
genes_missing <- setdiff(genes_magic, rownames(sct_data))
if (length(genes_missing)) warning("Genes not found within the SCT assay: ", paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", "))
genes_magic <- intersect(genes_magic, rownames(sct_data))
if (!length(genes_magic)) stop("None of the selected genes were found within the SCT assay.")
graph_genes <- intersect(unique(c(SeuratObject::VariableFeatures(obj[["SCT"]]), genes_magic)), rownames(sct_data))
npca_magic <- min(10L, length(graph_genes) - 1L, ncol(sct_data) - 1L)
if (npca_magic < 2L) stop("There are not enough genes or cells to run MAGIC.")
magic_data <- t(as.matrix(Rmagic::magic(
  data = t(sct_data[graph_genes, , drop = FALSE]),
  genes = genes_magic,
  npca = npca_magic,
  n.jobs = as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", unset = "1")),
  verbose = FALSE,
  seed = 123
)$result))
magic_data <- magic_data[genes_magic, colnames(obj), drop = FALSE]
obj@meta.data[, paste0(genes_magic, "_mag")] <- t(magic_data[, rownames(obj@meta.data), drop = FALSE])
# --- Visualize MAGIC-imputed gene expression ---
plots_list[["IC06_filtered_umap_GOI_magic"]] <- FeaturePlot(
  obj,
  features = c("PDCD1_mag", "ENTPD1_mag", paste0(genes_magic, "_mag")),
  ncol = 6,
  pt.size = 0.25
) &
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("#D9F2E6", "#52B788", "#2C7FB8", "#08306B"),
    oob = scales::squish,
    na.value = "grey80"
  ) &
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
plots_list[["IC06_filtered_umap_GOI_magic"]]
rm(sct_data, magic_data, graph_genes, genes_missing, npca_magic)
gc()
```

Ridge plots were generated to examine the expression distributions of CD8A, CD8B, CD4, ENTPD1, and PDCD1 across samples.

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
markers <- c("CD8A_mag", "CD4_mag", 
             "TNFRSF9_mag", "TNFRSF4_mag") #CD137 and OX-40, respectively (activation markers)
ridge_plots <- list()
for (i in markers) {
  x <- data.frame(
    marker_value = obj@meta.data[[i]],
    sample_type = obj@meta.data$sample_id
  )
  g <- ggplot(x, aes(x = marker_value, y = sample_type, fill = sample_type)) +
    geom_density_ridges(
      aes(point_color = 1, point_fill = sample_type),
      alpha = 0.75,
      jittered_points = TRUE,
      point_alpha = 0.1,
      point_color = "black",
      position = position_points_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
      point_shape = "|"
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
    labs(
      title = i,
      x = "MAGIC-imputed expression",
      y = "Sample",
      fill = "Sample"
    ) +
    theme_ic +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  ridge_plots[[i]] <- g
}
plots_list[["IC07_Magic_CD48_density"]] <- wrap_plots(ridge_plots, ncol = 2)
print(plots_list[["IC07_Magic_CD48_density"]])
rm(markers, ridge_plots, i, x, g)
```

# pdfCluster

Expression thresholds for CD4 and CD8A/CD8B were determined using density-based clustering (pdfCluster) applied to MAGIC-imputed expression values.
A deterministic threshold-selection procedure was implemented to eliminate run-to-run variability and ensure reproducibility.

```{r}
n_per_sample <- 750
sample_var <- obj@meta.data$sample_id
idx_list <- split(seq_along(sample_var), sample_var)
idx_selected <- unlist(lapply(idx_list, function(idx) {
  idx[seq_len(min(n_per_sample, length(idx)))]
}), use.names = FALSE)
```

Distribution of MAGIC-imputed CD4 expression.

```{r}
set.seed(123)
sc <- obj@meta.data$CD4_mag[idx_selected]
pd <- pdfCluster(sc, hmult=0.75)
cl <- groups(pd)
names(cl) <- names(sc)
table(cl)
tapply(sc, cl, summary)
dens <- density(sc)
pdfcluster_plots[["CD4"]] <- {
  grid.newpage()
  dens <- density(sc)
  plot(dens, main="CD4_mag", ylim=c(-0.005, max(dens$y)))
  abline(v=tapply(sc, cl, min)[-1], lty=3, lwd=2, col='gray')
  abline(v=tapply(sc, cl, max)[-1], lty=3, lwd=2, col='gray')
  abline(h=c(-0.001, -0.005))
  text(x=sc[cl==1], y=-0.001, col='green3', label='|')
  text(x=sc[cl==2], y=-0.005, col='red3', label='|')
  text(x=sc[cl==3], y=-0.005, col='purple', label='|')
  recordPlot()
}
x <- tapply(sc, cl, min)
x_sorted <- sort(x, na.last = NA)
thresholdCD4 <- x_sorted[2]
thresholdCD4 <- 0.1 #only for pt3385
rm(sc, pd, cl, dens)
```

Cells were classified as CD4+ or CD8+ T cells based on the expression thresholds determined using pdfCluster.

```{r}
# --- CD8+ T cells ---
obj@meta.data$CD8ind <- rep(FALSE, length(colnames(obj)))
obj@meta.data$CD8ind[obj@meta.data$CD8A_mag>thresholdCD8A & obj@meta.data$CD4_mag<thresholdCD4 & !(obj@meta.data$percent.rpa<20 & obj@meta.data$percent.mt > 15)] <- TRUE
# --- CD4+ T cells ---
obj$CD4ind <- rep(FALSE, length(colnames(obj)))
obj$CD4ind[obj$CD8A_mag<thresholdCD8A & obj$CD4_mag>thresholdCD4 & !(obj@meta.data$percent.rpa<20 & obj@meta.data$percent.mt > 15)] <- TRUE
# --- Consensus ---
obj$magic.method <- ifelse(obj$CD8ind == TRUE & obj$CD4ind == FALSE, "cd8",
                         ifelse(obj$CD8ind == FALSE & obj$CD4ind == TRUE, "cd4", "unknown"))
table(obj$magic.method)
```

Internal control: Assess the concordance between CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell classifications based on MAGIC-imputed expression and scGate annotations.

```{r}
annotation_consistency <- as.data.frame(
  table(
    magic_method = obj$magic.method,
    scGate_multi = obj$scGate_multi
  )
)
print(annotation_consistency)
tables_list$qc[["MAGIC_vs_scGate"]] <- annotation_consistency
p1 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "scGate_multi", split.by = "magic.method") + theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + ggtitle("magic.method_vs_scGate")
```

For the final CD4+/CD8+ T-cell classification, MAGIC-imputed expression was used as the primary criterion, while scGate annotations were used to validate lineage assignments and classify previously unassigned cells. Cells with conflicting CD4+/CD8+ assignments or classified as non-T cells by scGate were designated as unknown.

```{r}
obj$celltype <- dplyr::case_when(
  obj$scGate_multi %in% c(
    "Bcell", "Erythrocyte", "gdT", "HSPC", "Mast", "Monocyte", "Neutrophils", "NK", "panDC", "PlasmaCell", "Platelet", "Multi"
  ) ~ "unknown",
  obj$magic.method == "cd4" & obj$scGate_multi == "CD8T" ~ "unknown",
  obj$magic.method == "cd8" & obj$scGate_multi == "CD4T" ~ "unknown",
  obj$magic.method == "cd4" ~ "cd4",
  obj$magic.method == "cd8" ~ "cd8",
  obj$magic.method == "unknown" & obj$scGate_multi == "CD4T" ~ "cd4",
  obj$magic.method == "unknown" & obj$scGate_multi == "CD8T" ~ "cd8",
  TRUE ~ "unknown"
)
p2 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "scGate_multi", split.by = "celltype") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle("consensus")
plots_list[["IC09_celltype"]] <- wrap_plots(p1, p2, nrow = 2)
plots_list[["IC09_celltype"]]
rm(p1, p2)
```

```{r}
print(celltype_tcr_summary)
```

Internal control: Absolute numbers of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells with recovered TCR information were compared across experimental conditions to assess the additional TCR recovery achieved by integrating MiXCR with Cell Ranger.

recovery1 = TCRs recovered by Cell Ranger alone.
recovery2 = TCRs recovered by the combined Cell Ranger and MiXCR approach.

```{r}
meta <- obj@meta.data %>% filter(celltype %in% c("cd4", "cd8"))

# --- Internal control ---
tab1 <- table(meta$tag.tcr, meta$sample_id)
tab2 <- table(meta$tag.tcr_combi, meta$sample_id)
recovery1 <- 100 * tab1["yes", ] / colSums(tab1)
recovery2 <- 100 * tab2["yes", ] / colSums(tab2)
gain_pp <- recovery2 - recovery1
gain_yes <- tab2["yes", ] - tab1["yes", ]
tcr_recovery_summary <- data.frame(
  sample_id = names(recovery1),
  recovery_cellranger = round(as.numeric(recovery1), 2),
  recovery_combined = round(as.numeric(recovery2), 2),
  Delta_recovery_pp = round(as.numeric(gain_pp), 2),
  absolute_gain = as.numeric(gain_yes),
  row.names = NULL
)
print(tcr_recovery_summary)
tables_list$qc[["tcr_recovery_summary"]] <- tcr_recovery_summary
```

# subset

Subset CD4+ or CD8+ T cells for downstream analysis

⚠️ Set `compartment` to `cd4` or `cd8` before running the TCR analysis section.

```{r}
# --- Analysis parameters ---
compartment <- "cd8"
obj$sample_id <- sub("^PeptidePool$", "Pept_pool", as.character(obj$sample_id))
control_condition <- "Unpulsed"
deconv_conditions <- grep(
  "^R[0-9]+$",
  unique(as.character(obj$sample_id)),
  value = TRUE
)
if (length(deconv_conditions) == 0L) {
  stop("No deconvoluted conditions matching '^R[0-9]+$' found.")
}
deconv_condition <- deconv_conditions[[1]]
analysis_conditions <- c(
  control_condition,
  "CD3CD28",
  "Pept_pool",
  deconv_conditions
)
missing_analysis_conditions <- setdiff(
  analysis_conditions,
  unique(as.character(obj$sample_id))
)
if (length(missing_analysis_conditions) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Conditions not found in obj$sample_id: ",
    paste(missing_analysis_conditions, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
selected_conditions <- setdiff(
  analysis_conditions,
  control_condition
)
```

Differential gene expression was assessed for each stimulation condition relative to Unpulsed cells. TCR, mitochondrial, and ribosomal genes were excluded, retaining RPS6K-family genes. Differentially expressed genes were compiled across comparisons, and the top 100 unique genes were selected to generate an activation signature for downstream analysis.

```{r}
# --- Subset cells by T-cell compartment ---
obj_sub <- subset(obj, subset = celltype == compartment & !is.na(TCR_ID))
# --- Define differential expression comparisons against Unpulsed ---
DefaultAssay(obj_sub) <- "SCT"
obj_sub <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(obj_sub)
# --- Exclude TCR, mitochondrial, and ribosomal genes (retain RPS6K*) ---
exclude_pattern <- "^(TR[ABDG][VJCD]|MT-|RPL|MRPL|MRPS|RPS(?!6K))"
genes_keep <- rownames(obj_sub)[
  !grepl(exclude_pattern, rownames(obj_sub), perl = TRUE)
]
# --- Perform differential expression analyses ---
DEG_list <- list()
DEG_list$condition_vs_unpulsed <- lapply(
  setNames(
    selected_conditions,
    paste0(selected_conditions, "_vs_", control_condition)
  ),
  function(cond) {
    FindMarkers(
      obj_sub,
      ident.1 = cond,
      ident.2 = control_condition,
      group.by = "sample_id",
      assay = "SCT",
      slot = "data",
      features = genes_keep,
      test.use = "wilcox",
      min.pct = 0.1,
      logfc.threshold = 0.5,
      only.pos = TRUE
    ) |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") |>
      dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.01) |>
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_log2FC))
  }
)
# --- Compile condition-specific and combined DEG tables ---
DEG_list$combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  DEG_list$condition_vs_unpulsed,
  .id = "comparison"
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_log2FC))
# --- Select the top 100 unique genes for the activation signature ---
DEG_list$top_genes <- DEG_list$combined |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 100) |>
  dplyr::pull(gene) |>
  unique()
for (comparison in names(DEG_list$condition_vs_unpulsed)) {
  tables_list$markers[[paste0(toupper(compartment), "_", comparison, "_DEGs")]] <-
    DEG_list$condition_vs_unpulsed[[comparison]]
}
tables_list$markers[[paste0(toupper(compartment), "_DEGs_combined")]] <-
  DEG_list$combined
tables_list$markers[[paste0(toupper(compartment), "_signature_genes")]] <-
  tibble::tibble(gene = DEG_list$top_genes)
```

Calculate an activation score for each T cell using UCell and the dataset-derived activation gene signature.

```{r}
DefaultAssay(obj_sub) <- "RNA"
obj_sub <- UCell::AddModuleScore_UCell(
  obj_sub,
  features = list(activation = DEG_list$top_genes),
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "data",
  name = "_UCell"
)
```

```{r}
ref.use <- load.reference.map(ref = file.path(ref_dir, paste0(toupper(compartment), "T_human_ref_v1.rds")))
```

Following normalization and exclusion of TCR and BCR genes, dimensionality reduction and clustering were recalculated. The resulting clusters were examined to assess their structure and distribution within the CD4+ T-cell compartment.

```{r}
# --- Normalize data and exclude TCR/BCR genes ---
set.seed(123)
obj_sub <- SCTransform(obj_sub, assay = "RNA", seed.use = 123, verbose = FALSE)
DefaultAssay(obj_sub) <- "SCT"
vf <- VariableFeatures(obj_sub)
vf <- vf[!grepl("^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^IG[HKL][VDJ]", vf)]
VariableFeatures(obj_sub) <- vf
# --- Recalculate PCA, UMAP, and clustering ---
obj_sub <- RunPCA(obj_sub, npcs = 30, seed.use = 123)
obj_sub <- FindNeighbors(obj_sub, dims = 1:20)
obj_sub <- FindClusters(obj_sub, resolution = 0.5, random.seed = 123)
obj_sub <- RunUMAP(obj_sub, dims = 1:20, n.neighbors = 50, min.dist = 0.3, seed.use = 123)
table(obj_sub$seurat_clusters)
table(obj_sub$seurat_clusters, obj_sub$sample_id)
# --- Quality control and visualization of T-cell clusters ---
g1 <- DimPlot(obj_sub, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.15) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle(paste0(toupper(compartment), " clusters"))
g2 <- DimPlot(obj_sub, group.by = "sample_id", pt.size = 0.15) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle("Sample")
g3 <- DimPlot(obj_sub, group.by = "functional.cluster", pt.size = 0.15, cols = phenotype_colors) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle("ProjecTILs")
g4 <- FeaturePlot(
  obj_sub,
  features = "activation_UCell",
  pt.size = 0.25
) &
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("#D9F2E6", "#52B788", "#2C7FB8", "#08306B"),
    oob = scales::squish,
    na.value = "grey80"
  ) &
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
plots_list[[paste0("IC10_", compartment, "_reclustering")]] <- wrap_plots(g1, g2, g3, g4, ncol = 2)
print(plots_list[[paste0("IC10_", compartment, "_reclustering")]])
```

# rank

This analysis identifies TCR clonotypes exhibiting increased activation following peptide-pool or individual peptide (Rx) stimulation compared with the unstimulated control (Unpulsed). CD3/CD28 stimulation serves as a positive control for T-cell activation. The accompanying table ranks antigen-responsive clonotypes for functional validation and includes selected putative negative controls. UMAP plots illustrate the distribution and phenotypic characteristics of selected clonotypes across experimental conditions.

## activated cells

**Activation threshold:** Cells with activation_UCell scores exceeding the 99th percentile of TCR-assigned Unpulsed cells are classified as activated.
**Statistical testing:** Clonotypes represented by ≥2 cells per condition are evaluated using a one-sided binomial test against the global Unpulsed activation background, followed by Benjamini–Hochberg correction within each condition (adjusted P < 0.01).
**Tier classification:**
Tier 1 — deconvoluted peptide response.  A statistically significant increase in activation (adjusted P < 0.01) is detected in at least one individual peptide (R) condition, whether or not Pept_pool is also significant. This identifies one or more R conditions associated with the response.
Tier 2 — peptide-pool response only.  Pept_pool shows a statistically significant response (adjusted P < 0.01), but no individual R condition is significant. The data therefore do not resolve a specific responding R condition.

```{r}
# --- Define experimental conditions and statistical parameters ---
control_condition <- "Unpulsed"
deconv_conditions <- grep(
  "^R[0-9]+$",
  unique(as.character(obj_sub$sample_id)),
  value = TRUE
)
if (length(deconv_conditions) == 0L) {
  stop("No deconvoluted conditions matching '^R[0-9]+$' found.")
}
target_conditions <- c("Pept_pool", deconv_conditions)
analysis_conditions <- c(control_condition, "CD3CD28", target_conditions)
padj_cutoff <- 0.01
activation_quantile <- 0.99
# --- Classify activated cells using the Unpulsed reference ---
meta <- obj_sub[[]] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TCR_ID)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(sample_id = as.character(sample_id))
if (anyNA(meta$activation_UCell)) {
  stop("Missing activation_UCell scores.")
}
threshold <- quantile(
  meta$activation_UCell[meta$sample_id == control_condition],
  activation_quantile
)
if (!is.finite(threshold)) {
  stop("Cannot calculate activation threshold from Unpulsed cells.")
}
meta$activated <- meta$activation_UCell > threshold
p0 <- max(mean(meta$activated[meta$sample_id == control_condition]), 1 - activation_quantile)
# --- Test clonotype activation enrichment and adjust P values ---
clone_stats <- meta |>
  dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% analysis_conditions) |>
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id, TCR_ID) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), act = sum(activated), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    p = ifelse(
      n >= 2,
      mapply(function(k, size) binom.test(k, size, p0, alternative = "greater")$p.value, act, n),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id) |>
  dplyr::mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
# --- Identify significant responses across deconvoluted R conditions ---
deconv_stats <- clone_stats |>
  dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% deconv_conditions) |>
  dplyr::mutate(sig = dplyr::coalesce(p_adj < padj_cutoff, FALSE)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(TCR_ID) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    sig_deconv = any(sig),
    rx_response = paste(
      deconv_conditions[deconv_conditions %in% sample_id[sig]],
      collapse = " + "
    ),
    target_pct_R = if (any(sig)) {
      max(100 * act[sig] / n[sig])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    total_act_R = sum(act),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# --- Define response categories and their ordering ---
rx_response_levels <- sort(unique(deconv_stats$rx_response[nzchar(deconv_stats$rx_response)]))
response_levels <- c(
  paste0(rx_response_levels, " + Pept_pool"),
  rx_response_levels,
  "Pept_pool"
)
# --- Retrieve clonotype IDs and TCR chain annotations ---
tcr_clones <- meta |>
  dplyr::distinct(TCR_ID, CloneID)
if (anyDuplicated(tcr_clones$TCR_ID)) {
  stop("Multiple CloneIDs associated with the same TCR_ID.")
}
tcr_chains <- meta |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(chains_combi)) |>
  dplyr::count(TCR_ID, chains_combi, name = "cells") |>
  dplyr::group_by(TCR_ID) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(cells), chains_combi, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::transmute(TCR_ID, chains = chains_combi)
# --- Format activated-cell counts and percentages ---
format_activation <- function(act, n) {
  ifelse(
    n > 0,
    sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", act, n, 100 * act / pmax(n, 1)),
    NA_character_
  )
}
# --- Summarize activation and adjusted P values by condition ---
activation_table <- clone_stats |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = analysis_conditions),
    activation = format_activation(act, n),
    padj = signif(p_adj, 2)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(TCR_ID, sample_id, activation, padj) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = TCR_ID,
    names_from = sample_id,
    values_from = c(activation, padj),
    names_glue = "{sample_id}_{.value}",
    names_expand = TRUE
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(
    ~ sub("_activation$", "", .x),
    dplyr::ends_with("_activation")
  )
# --- Classify antigen-responsive clonotypes and compile annotations ---
TCR_priority <- clone_stats |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = analysis_conditions)
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = TCR_ID,
    names_from = sample_id,
    values_from = c(n, act, p_adj),
    names_glue = "{sample_id}_{.value}",
    names_expand = TRUE,
    values_fill = list(n = 0L, act = 0L)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(deconv_stats, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig_pept = dplyr::coalesce(Pept_pool_p_adj < padj_cutoff, FALSE),
    sig_deconv = dplyr::coalesce(sig_deconv, FALSE),
    tier = dplyr::case_when(
      sig_deconv ~ "Tier 1",
      sig_pept ~ "Tier 2"
    ),
    response = dplyr::case_when(
      sig_deconv & sig_pept ~ paste0(rx_response, " + Pept_pool"),
      sig_deconv ~ rx_response,
      sig_pept ~ "Pept_pool"
    ),
    response = factor(response, levels = response_levels),
    target_pct = dplyr::if_else(
      sig_deconv,
      target_pct_R,
      100 * Pept_pool_act / pmax(Pept_pool_n, 1)
    ),
    baseline_pct = dplyr::if_else(
      .data[[paste0(control_condition, "_n")]] > 0,
      100 * .data[[paste0(control_condition, "_act")]] / pmax(.data[[paste0(control_condition, "_n")]], 1),
      NA_real_
    ),
    delta_pp = target_pct - baseline_pct,
    total_act = Pept_pool_act + dplyr::coalesce(total_act_R, 0L)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tier)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(tier, response, dplyr::desc(delta_pp), dplyr::desc(target_pct), dplyr::desc(total_act)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(tcr_chains, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(tcr_clones, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::select(
    TCR_ID,
    tier,
    response,
    CloneID,
    chains
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(activation_table, by = "TCR_ID")
# --- Arrange condition-specific output columns ---
condition_cols <- unlist(lapply(
  analysis_conditions,
  function(x) c(x, paste0(x, "_padj"))
))
TCR_priority <- TCR_priority |>
  dplyr::select(
    TCR_ID,
    tier,
    response,
    dplyr::all_of(condition_cols),
    CloneID,
    chains
  )
# --- Validate TCR assignments and summarize significant responses ---
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(TCR_priority$TCR_ID))
cat("Deconvoluted conditions:", paste(deconv_conditions, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Activation threshold:", threshold, "\n")
cat("Binomial background rate:", p0, "\n")
print(table(TCR_priority$tier, TCR_priority$response, useNA = "ifany"))
```

## phenotypic shifts

**Phenotypic annotation:** For each antigen-responsive clonotype, the dominant Seurat cluster (SCT resolution 0.5) and ProjecTILs functional state were determined separately for each experimental condition. Annotations include the percentage of clonotype cells assigned to the dominant cluster or functional state within each condition. When multiple states are equally represented, all are reported.

**Missing annotations:**
ND: The clonotype was not detected in the corresponding condition.
Unannotated: The clonotype was detected, but no valid phenotypic annotation was available.

Differences in phenotypic composition across conditions are descriptive and do not necessarily indicate cell-state transitions. Their interpretation depends on the number of cells representing each clonotype.

```{r}
# --- Define conditions for phenotypic annotation ---
annotation_conditions <- c(control_condition, "CD3CD28", target_conditions)
# --- Annotate dominant Seurat clusters (SCT resolution 0.5) ---
seurat_shifts <- phenotype_shifts(
  data = meta,
  phenotype = "SCT_snn_res.0.5",
  suffix = "cluster"
)
# --- Annotate dominant ProjecTILs functional states ---
functional_shifts <- phenotype_shifts(
  data = meta,
  phenotype = "functional.cluster",
  suffix = "phenotype"
)
# --- Integrate phenotypic annotations into the TCR priority table ---
TCR_priority <- TCR_priority |>
  dplyr::select(
    -dplyr::matches("^(seurat|projectils)_.*_top[123]$"),
    -dplyr::any_of(c(
      paste0(annotation_conditions, "_cluster"),
      paste0(annotation_conditions, "_phenotype")
    ))
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(seurat_shifts, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(functional_shifts, by = "TCR_ID")
# --- Validate clonotype uniqueness and summarize antigen-responsive TCRs ---
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(TCR_priority$TCR_ID))
cat("Total prioritized TCRs:", nrow(TCR_priority), "\n")
print(table(TCR_priority$tier, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(TCR_priority$response, useNA = "ifany"))
```

## deep TCRb-Seq

**Bulk TCRβ-seq integration:** Single-cell TCR clonotypes were matched to productive bulk TCRβ-seq clonotypes using the exact CDR3β nucleotide sequence and TRBJ gene identity. Clonotype frequencies and abundance ranks were obtained independently for each bulk repertoire, considering all productive clonotypes. Unmatched TCRs were retained with missing bulk annotations.

```{r}
# --- Load bulk TCRβ-seq data ---
bulk_sample <- paste0("CHUM_", sub("^pt", "", sample))
bulk <- readRDS("/mnt/petasan_immuno/raw_data/itag/collabs/sturcotte/clonotypes_adaptive_bulk_productivefreqs_update.rds")
bulk_pt <- bulk[[bulk_sample]]
if (is.null(bulk_pt)) {
  stop("Bulk sample not found: ", bulk_sample)
}
# --- Extract beta-chain identifiers (CDR3 nucleotide sequence + TRBJ) ---
beta_pairs <- obj_sub[[]] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TCR_ID)) |>
  dplyr::select(TCR_ID, chains, cdr3_nt, j_gene) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cdr3_j = Map(
      function(chain, nt, j) {
        if (anyNA(c(chain, nt, j))) {
          return(NA_character_)
        }
        chain <- trimws(strsplit(chain, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
        nt <- trimws(strsplit(nt, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
        j <- trimws(strsplit(j, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
        if (length(chain) != length(nt) || length(nt) != length(j)) {
          return(NA_character_)
        }
        beta_idx <- which(
          chain == "TRB" &
            grepl("^TRBJ", j) &
            grepl("^[ACGT]+$", nt)
        )
        if (length(beta_idx) == 0L) {
          return(NA_character_)
        }
        paste0(
          nt[beta_idx],
          "_",
          sub("\\*.*$", "", j[beta_idx])
        )
      },
      chains, cdr3_nt, j_gene
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest_longer(cdr3_j) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cdr3_j), cdr3_j != "")
# --- Select the most frequently observed beta-chain identifier per TCR ---
tcr_beta_key <- beta_pairs |>
  dplyr::count(TCR_ID, cdr3_j) |>
  dplyr::group_by(TCR_ID) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n), cdr3_j, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(TCR_ID, cdr3_j)
# --- Validate beta-chain assignments and matching coverage ---
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tcr_beta_key$TCR_ID))
cat("TCRs with valid beta-chain keys:", nrow(tcr_beta_key), "\n")
cat("TCRs matching productive bulk:", sum(
  tcr_beta_key$cdr3_j %in% bulk_pt$cdr3_j[
    !is.na(bulk_pt$productive) & bulk_pt$productive == "yes"
  ]
), "\n")
print(head(tcr_beta_key, n = 5))
# --- Calculate clonotype frequencies and ranks across productive repertoires ---
freq_cols <- c("blood", "tumor", "PE", "bulk", "TIDAL01")
rank_columns <- c("Blood_rank", "Tumor_rank", "PE_rank", "Bulk_rank", "TIDAL01_rank")
bulk_ranks <- bulk_pt |>
  dplyr::filter(productive == "yes") |>
  dplyr::select(clonotype, dplyr::all_of(freq_cols)) |>
  dplyr::distinct()
if (anyDuplicated(bulk_ranks$clonotype)) {
  stop("Inconsistent frequencies for duplicated bulk clonotypes.")
}
# --- Count productive clonotypes detected in each repertoire ---
rank_totals <- vapply(
  freq_cols,
  function(x) sum(bulk_ranks[[x]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  integer(1)
)
rank_labels <- stats::setNames(
  paste0(rank_columns, " (N=", rank_totals, ")"),
  rank_columns
)
bulk_ranks <- bulk_ranks |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(freq_cols),
      ~ dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(.x) & .x > 0,
        dplyr::min_rank(dplyr::desc(.x)),
        NA_integer_
      ),
      .names = "rank_{.col}"
    )
  )
# --- Match beta-chain identifiers to bulk frequencies and ranks ---
bulk_key <- bulk_pt |>
  dplyr::filter(productive == "yes") |>
  dplyr::select(cdr3_j, bulk_clonotype = clonotype) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    bulk_ranks |> dplyr::rename(bulk_clonotype = clonotype),
    by = "bulk_clonotype"
  )
if (anyDuplicated(bulk_key$cdr3_j[!is.na(bulk_key$cdr3_j)])) {
  stop("Duplicated cdr3_j keys in bulk data. Review ambiguous clonotype matches.")
}
# --- Integrate bulk TCRβ-seq information into the priority table ---
TCR_priority_bulk <- TCR_priority |>
  dplyr::left_join(tcr_beta_key, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(bulk_key, by = "cdr3_j", na_matches = "never")
# --- Validate matching and summarize bulk repertoire coverage ---
stopifnot(nrow(TCR_priority_bulk) == nrow(TCR_priority))
cat("Prioritized TCRs:", nrow(TCR_priority_bulk), "\n")
cat("TCRs matched to bulk:", sum(!is.na(TCR_priority_bulk$bulk_clonotype)), "\n")
cat("TCRs detected in tumor:", sum(TCR_priority_bulk$tumor > 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
print(rank_totals)
# --- Rename and format bulk repertoire columns ---
TCR_priority_bulk <- TCR_priority_bulk |>
  dplyr::rename(
    Condition = response,
    Tumor_freq = tumor,
    Tumor_rank = rank_tumor,
    Blood_freq = blood,
    Blood_rank = rank_blood,
    PE_freq = PE,
    PE_rank = rank_PE,
    Bulk_freq = bulk,
    Bulk_rank = rank_bulk,
    TIDAL01_freq = TIDAL01,
    TIDAL01_rank = rank_TIDAL01,
    Clone_ID = CloneID
  )
TCR_priority_bulk <- TCR_priority_bulk |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(c("Tumor_freq", "Blood_freq", "PE_freq", "Bulk_freq", "TIDAL01_freq")),
      ~ dplyr::na_if(.x, 0)
    )
  )
# --- Arrange activation, phenotype, and bulk repertoire columns ---
condition_cols <- unlist(lapply(
  target_conditions,
  function(x) c(x, paste0(x, "_padj"))
))
annotation_conditions <- c(control_condition, "CD3CD28", target_conditions)
TCR_priority_bulk <- TCR_priority_bulk |>
  dplyr::select(
    TCR_ID,
    tier,
    Condition,
    dplyr::all_of(control_condition),
    dplyr::all_of(paste0(control_condition, "_padj")),
    CD3CD28, CD3CD28_padj,
    dplyr::all_of(condition_cols),
    dplyr::all_of(paste0(annotation_conditions, "_cluster")),
    dplyr::all_of(paste0(annotation_conditions, "_phenotype")),
    Tumor_freq, Tumor_rank,
    Blood_freq, Blood_rank,
    PE_freq, PE_rank,
    Bulk_freq, Bulk_rank,
    TIDAL01_freq, TIDAL01_rank,
    Clone_ID,
    chains
  )
```

## assessment

**Response robustness assessment:** To assess the reliability of antigen-induced activation, the proportion of activated cells was evaluated using the lower bound of the 95% Wilson confidence interval. Unlike the observed activation percentage, the Wilson lower bound accounts for the number of cells analyzed. For example, an 80% activation rate based on only 5 cells provides less reliable evidence than the same percentage based on 100 cells. The Wilson lower bound is therefore more conservative when cell numbers are small.

For Tier 1 clonotypes, the statistically significant R condition with the highest Wilson lower bound was selected as the strongest response. For Tier 2 clonotypes, the Pept_pool response was used. For each clonotype, the number of cells, number of activated cells, activation percentage, and Wilson lower bound were retained. Baseline activation in Unpulsed was also recorded to support subsequent evaluation of antigen-induced activation.

These metrics are used to rank clonotypes for functional validation. The Wilson lower bound is not an additional statistical test and does not independently establish antigen specificity.

```{r}
# --- Define response robustness and ranking parameters ---
min_baseline_cells <- 5L
min_delta_pp <- 15
wilson_bin_pp <- 5
# --- Calculate the lower bound of the 95% Wilson confidence interval ---
wilson_lower <- function(act, n) {
  z <- qnorm(0.975)
  n_safe <- pmax(n, 1)
  p <- act / n_safe
  lower <- (
    p + z^2 / (2 * n_safe) -
      z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_safe + z^2 / (4 * n_safe^2))
  ) / (1 + z^2 / n_safe)
  ifelse(n > 0, 100 * pmax(lower, 0), NA_real_)
}
# --- Summarize activated and total cells per clonotype and condition ---
activation_counts <- clone_stats |>
  dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% c(control_condition, target_conditions)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = c(control_condition, target_conditions))
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = TCR_ID,
    names_from = sample_id,
    values_from = c(n, act),
    names_glue = "{sample_id}_{.value}",
    names_expand = TRUE,
    values_fill = list(n = 0L, act = 0L)
  )
# --- Identify the strongest significant antigen-induced response per TCR ---
target_evidence <- clone_stats |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    TCR_priority |> dplyr::select(TCR_ID, tier),
    by = "TCR_ID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    (tier == "Tier 1" &
       sample_id %in% deconv_conditions &
       dplyr::coalesce(p_adj < padj_cutoff, FALSE)) |
      (tier == "Tier 2" & sample_id == "Pept_pool")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    target_pct = 100 * act / pmax(n, 1),
    wilson_pct = wilson_lower(act, n)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(TCR_ID) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(wilson_pct),
    dplyr::desc(target_pct),
    dplyr::desc(act),
    sample_id,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    TCR_ID,
    target_n = n,
    target_act = act,
    target_pct,
    wilson_pct
  )
# --- Validate availability of response evidence for prioritized TCRs ---
if (!setequal(TCR_priority$TCR_ID, target_evidence$TCR_ID)) {
  stop("Missing target evidence for one or more prioritized TCRs.")
}
```

## prioritisation

All prioritized positive clonotypes require at least one Unpulsed cell and <5% basal activation. To qualify as L1 or L2, the relevant R or Pept_pool condition must contain >5 clonotype cells.

**Functional prioritization:**
- Tier 1–L1: At least one individual R condition has both statistically significant activation (adjusted P < 0.01) and >60% activated cells among at least six clonotype cells in that same condition.
- Tier 1–L2: At least one R condition is statistically significant, but none meets all L1 requirements. The clonotype is retained because Pept_pool has ≥50% activated cells among at least six cells, even if Pept_pool is not statistically significant. A Tier 1–L2 clonotype can respond strongly in Pept_pool but fail the stricter R-condition L1 requirement.
- Tier 2–L1: Pept_pool is statistically significant (adjusted P < 0.01) and has >60% activated cells among at least six clonotype cells; no individual R condition is significant.
- Tier 2–L2: Pept_pool is statistically significant (adjusted P < 0.01) and has 50–60% activated cells among at least six clonotype cells; no individual R condition is significant. Used only if there are no Tier 2–L1 candidates.

**Interpretation:**
- Tier 1 identifies statistically significant activation in deconvoluted R conditions.
- Tier 2 identifies statistically significant activation in Pept_pool without significant activation in any R condition.
- L1 identifies clonotypes exceeding 60% activation in the Tier-defining condition, with the required statistical evidence.
- L2 provides a Pept_pool-based rescue for clonotypes that do not meet L1 criteria.
- Tier 1 L2 clonotypes may exhibit >60% activation in Pept_pool while remaining below the L1 threshold in significant R conditions.

```{r}
# --- Identify TCRs with >60% activation in significant R conditions ---
rx_priority <- clone_stats |>
  dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% deconv_conditions) |>
  dplyr::group_by(TCR_ID) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rx_pass_60 = any(
      n > 5 &
        dplyr::coalesce(p_adj < padj_cutoff, FALSE) &
        100 * act / pmax(n, 1) > 60
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# --- Assign functional levels and rank antigen-responsive TCRs ---
original_columns <- append(colnames(TCR_priority_bulk), "Prioritize", after = 1)
original_columns[original_columns == "tier"] <- "Tier"
original_columns <- append(original_columns, "Level", after = match("Tier", original_columns))
TCR_priority_bulk <- TCR_priority_bulk |>
  dplyr::rename(Tier = tier) |>
  dplyr::left_join(activation_counts, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(target_evidence, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(rx_priority, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    control_n = .data[[paste0(control_condition, "_n")]],
    control_act = .data[[paste0(control_condition, "_act")]],
    Pept_pool_pct = 100 * Pept_pool_act / pmax(Pept_pool_n, 1),
    baseline_pass = control_n > 0 &
      100 * control_act / pmax(control_n, 1) < 5,
    pass_L1 = dplyr::coalesce(
      dplyr::if_else(
        Tier == "Tier 1",
        rx_pass_60,
        Pept_pool_n > 5 & Pept_pool_pct > 60
      ) & baseline_pass,
      FALSE
    ),
    pass_L2 = dplyr::coalesce(
      !pass_L1 &
        Pept_pool_n > 5 &
        Pept_pool_pct >= 50 &
        baseline_pass,
      FALSE
    ),
    Level = dplyr::case_when(
      pass_L1 ~ "L1",
      Tier == "Tier 1" & pass_L2 ~ "L2",
      Tier == "Tier 2" & !any(pass_L1 & Tier == "Tier 2") & pass_L2 ~ "L2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Prioritize = !is.na(Level),
    baseline_pct = dplyr::if_else(
      control_n >= min_baseline_cells,
      100 * control_act / pmax(control_n, 1),
      NA_real_
    ),
    delta_pp = target_pct - baseline_pct,
    wilson_bin = floor(wilson_pct / wilson_bin_pp),
    induction_order = dplyr::case_when(
      control_n >= min_baseline_cells & delta_pp >= min_delta_pp ~ 1L,
      control_n < min_baseline_cells ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ 3L
    ),
    condition_order = dplyr::case_when(
      Condition == "Pept_pool" ~ 3L,
      grepl("Pept_pool", as.character(Condition), fixed = TRUE) ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 2L
    ),
    tumor_rank_sort = dplyr::coalesce(as.numeric(Tumor_rank), Inf)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    Tier,
    Level,
    induction_order,
    dplyr::desc(wilson_bin),
    condition_order,
    tumor_rank_sort,
    dplyr::desc(wilson_pct),
    dplyr::desc(delta_pp),
    dplyr::desc(target_act),
    TCR_ID
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(original_columns))
# --- Validate prioritization results and table structure ---
stopifnot(
  nrow(TCR_priority_bulk) == nrow(TCR_priority),
  !anyDuplicated(TCR_priority_bulk$TCR_ID),
  !anyNA(TCR_priority_bulk$Prioritize),
  setequal(TCR_priority_bulk$TCR_ID, TCR_priority$TCR_ID),
  identical(colnames(TCR_priority_bulk), original_columns)
)
# --- Add repertoire sizes to bulk rank column names ---
TCR_priority_bulk <- TCR_priority_bulk |>
  dplyr::rename_with(
    ~ unname(rank_labels[.x]),
    .cols = dplyr::all_of(rank_columns)
  )
# --- Summarize TCR prioritization results ---
tables_list$tcr[[paste0("prioritized_", compartment, "_tcrs_for_validation")]] <- TCR_priority_bulk
tables_list$tcr[[paste0("prioritized_", compartment, "_tcrs_for_validation")]]
rm(
  freq_cols, rank_columns, rank_totals, rank_labels,
  bulk_ranks, condition_cols, annotation_conditions,
  original_columns, activation_counts, target_evidence,
  rx_priority, wilson_lower
)
```

## negative controls

Aim: Three putative negative-control TCRs were selected, prioritizing clonotypes that respond to CD3/CD28 but show minimal peptide-induced activation (C1/C2). Clonotypes detected only in control conditions were used as alternatives (C3).

C1 — strongest negative-control evidence.  Detected in Unpulsed (at least one cell), with >50% activation among at >5 CD3CD28 cells, but <2% activated cells in every Pept_pool/R condition where detected (with at least one such condition). This supports general T-cell responsiveness with little observed peptide-induced activation.
C2 — fewer CD3CD28 cells.  Same criteria as C1, but >50% CD3CD28 activation is observed among only one to five clonotype cells. The peptide-stimulation evidence is similar to C1 but CD3CD28 support is based on fewer cells .
C3 — not detected in peptide-stimulated samples.  The clonotype is absent from every Pept_pool/R condition and has at least two cells across Unpulsed and/or CD3CD28. Detection in both control conditions is preferred. Absence from peptide-stimulated samples is not evidence of functional non-reactivity.

Selection order: C1 → C2 → C3 until three controls are obtained.

```{r}
# --- Define negative-control selection criteria ---
n_negative_controls <- 3L
min_CD3CD28_cells <- 5L
min_CD3CD28_pct <- 50
max_target_pct <- 2
min_fallback_cells <- 2L
# --- Summarize clonotype activation in Unpulsed and CD3CD28 ---
source_stats <- clone_stats |>
  dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% c(control_condition, "CD3CD28")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(TCR_ID) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Unpulsed_n = sum(n[sample_id == control_condition]),
    CD3CD28_n = sum(n[sample_id == "CD3CD28"]),
    CD3CD28_act = sum(act[sample_id == "CD3CD28"]),
    source_n = sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    CD3CD28_pct = 100 * CD3CD28_act / pmax(CD3CD28_n, 1)
  )
# --- Summarize activation across antigen-stimulation conditions ---
target_stats <- clone_stats |>
  dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% target_conditions) |>
  dplyr::group_by(TCR_ID) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    target_max_pct = max(100 * act / n),
    target_total_cells = sum(n),
    target_conditions_detected = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# --- Exclude antigen-responsive TCRs and rank negative-control candidates ---
positive_tcr_ids <- TCR_priority$TCR_ID
negative_pool <- source_stats |>
  dplyr::filter(!(TCR_ID %in% positive_tcr_ids)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(target_stats, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    selection_level = dplyr::case_when(
      Unpulsed_n > 0 &
        CD3CD28_n > min_CD3CD28_cells &
        CD3CD28_pct > min_CD3CD28_pct &
        !is.na(target_max_pct) &
        target_max_pct < max_target_pct ~ 1L,
      Unpulsed_n > 0 &
        CD3CD28_n > 0 &
        CD3CD28_pct > min_CD3CD28_pct &
        !is.na(target_max_pct) &
        target_max_pct < max_target_pct ~ 2L,
      source_n >= min_fallback_cells &
        is.na(target_max_pct) ~ 3L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    source_conditions_detected = as.integer(Unpulsed_n > 0) +
      as.integer(CD3CD28_n > 0),
    target_total_cells = dplyr::coalesce(target_total_cells, 0L),
    target_conditions_detected = dplyr::coalesce(target_conditions_detected, 0L)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(selection_level)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    selection_level,
    dplyr::desc(dplyr::if_else(selection_level == 3L, source_conditions_detected, 0L)),
    dplyr::desc(dplyr::if_else(selection_level <= 2L, CD3CD28_act, 0L)),
    dplyr::desc(target_conditions_detected),
    dplyr::desc(target_total_cells),
    dplyr::desc(source_n),
    TCR_ID
  )
# --- Summarize candidate availability across C1–C3 categories ---
cat("Available negative controls by selection level:\n")
print(
  tibble::tibble(Level = paste0("C", 1:3)) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      negative_pool |>
        dplyr::count(selection_level, name = "n_candidates") |>
        dplyr::mutate(Level = paste0("C", selection_level)) |>
        dplyr::select(Level, n_candidates),
      by = "Level"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(n_candidates = dplyr::coalesce(n_candidates, 0L))
)
# --- Select the three highest-ranked negative controls ---
if (nrow(negative_pool) < n_negative_controls) {
  stop("Fewer than three negative control candidates meet the hierarchical criteria.")
}
negative_controls_selected <- negative_pool |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = n_negative_controls) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Tier = "Negative control",
    Level = paste0("C", selection_level)
  )
negative_tcr_ids <- negative_controls_selected$TCR_ID
# --- Inspect selected negative controls ---
print(
  negative_controls_selected |>
    dplyr::select(
      TCR_ID,
      Tier,
      Level,
      Unpulsed_n,
      CD3CD28_n,
      CD3CD28_act,
      CD3CD28_pct,
      source_n,
      target_max_pct,
      target_total_cells,
      target_conditions_detected
    ),
  n = Inf
)
# --- Annotate Seurat clusters and ProjecTILs functional states ---
negative_clusters <- negative_phenotype_shifts(
  data = meta,
  phenotype = "SCT_snn_res.0.5",
  suffix = "cluster"
)
negative_phenotypes <- negative_phenotype_shifts(
  data = meta,
  phenotype = "functional.cluster",
  suffix = "phenotype"
)
# --- Integrate activation, phenotype, TCR and bulk annotations ---
negative_controls <- negative_controls_selected |>
  dplyr::select(TCR_ID, Tier, Level) |>
  dplyr::left_join(activation_table, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(negative_clusters, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(negative_phenotypes, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(tcr_clones, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(tcr_chains, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(tcr_beta_key, by = "TCR_ID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(bulk_key, by = "cdr3_j", na_matches = "never")
# --- Standardize bulk repertoire annotations ---
negative_controls <- negative_controls |>
  dplyr::rename(
    Tumor_freq = tumor,
    Tumor_rank = rank_tumor,
    Blood_freq = blood,
    Blood_rank = rank_blood,
    PE_freq = PE,
    PE_rank = rank_PE,
    Bulk_freq = bulk,
    Bulk_rank = rank_bulk,
    TIDAL01_freq = TIDAL01,
    TIDAL01_rank = rank_TIDAL01,
    Clone_ID = CloneID
  )
negative_controls <- negative_controls |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(c("Tumor_freq", "Blood_freq", "PE_freq", "Bulk_freq", "TIDAL01_freq")),
      ~ dplyr::na_if(.x, 0)
    )
  )
# --- Align negative-control annotations with the positive-candidate table ---
positive_table <- TCR_priority_bulk |>
  dplyr::filter(Tier %in% c("Tier 1", "Tier 2"))
rank_columns <- c("Tumor_rank", "Blood_rank", "PE_rank", "Bulk_rank", "TIDAL01_rank")
for (rank_col in rank_columns) {
  rank_name <- grep(
    paste0("^", rank_col, " \\(N=[0-9]+\\)$"),
    colnames(positive_table),
    value = TRUE
  )
  if (length(rank_name) != 1L) {
    stop("Cannot identify bulk rank column: ", rank_col)
  }
  colnames(negative_controls)[colnames(negative_controls) == rank_col] <- rank_name
}
negative_controls <- negative_controls |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Prioritize = FALSE,
    Condition = positive_table$Condition[NA_integer_]
  )
for (column in setdiff(colnames(positive_table), colnames(negative_controls))) {
  negative_controls[[column]] <- positive_table[[column]][NA_integer_]
}
negative_controls <- negative_controls |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(colnames(positive_table)))
# --- Append negative controls to the final prioritization table ---
TCR_priority_bulk <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  positive_table,
  negative_controls
)
# --- Validate negative-control assignments and table integrity ---
stopifnot(
  nrow(negative_controls) == n_negative_controls,
  nrow(TCR_priority_bulk) == nrow(positive_table) + n_negative_controls,
  !anyDuplicated(TCR_priority_bulk$TCR_ID),
  identical(colnames(TCR_priority_bulk), colnames(positive_table)),
  !anyNA(TCR_priority_bulk$Prioritize),
  all(negative_controls$Tier == "Negative control"),
  all(negative_controls$Level %in% c("C1", "C2", "C3")),
  all(is.na(negative_controls$Condition))
)
cat("Negative controls added:", nrow(negative_controls), "\n")
print(table(negative_controls$Level))
cat("Total TCRs:", nrow(TCR_priority_bulk), "\n")
# --- Store the updated TCR prioritization table ---
tables_list$tcr[[paste0("prioritized_", compartment, "_tcrs_for_validation")]] <- TCR_priority_bulk
tables_list$tcr[[paste0("prioritized_", compartment, "_tcrs_for_validation")]]
negative_controls
```

## umap plots

```{r}
# --- Select up to 12 prioritized TCRs and all negative controls ---
top_tcrs <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  TCR_priority_bulk |>
    dplyr::filter(Prioritize == TRUE) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 12),
  TCR_priority_bulk |>
    dplyr::filter(Tier == "Negative control", Level %in% c("C1", "C2", "C3"))
)
if (nrow(top_tcrs) == 0) {
  stop("No prioritized TCRs or negative controls found.")
}
# --- Summarize selected TCRs for visualization ---
cat("Prioritized TCRs:", sum(top_tcrs$Prioritize == TRUE), "\n")
cat("Negative controls:", sum(top_tcrs$Tier == "Negative control"), "\n")
cat("Total TCRs for plotting:", nrow(top_tcrs), "\n")
# --- Define experimental condition order ---
condition_order <- c(control_condition, "CD3CD28", "Pept_pool", deconv_conditions)
obj_plot <- obj_sub
obj_plot$sample_id <- factor(
  as.character(obj_plot$sample_id),
  levels = condition_order
)
# --- Retrieve Seurat cluster colors ---
cluster_levels <- levels(factor(obj_plot$SCT_snn_res.0.5))
cluster_plot <- DimPlot(
  obj_plot,
  group.by = "SCT_snn_res.0.5"
)
cluster_scale <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(cluster_plot)$plot$scales$get_scales("colour")
cluster_colors <- stats::setNames(cluster_scale$map(cluster_levels), cluster_levels)
# --- Generate condition-specific UMAPs for each selected TCR ---
tcr_umaps <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(top_tcrs)), function(i) {
  tcr <- top_tcrs$TCR_ID[i]
  cells_tcr <- colnames(obj_plot)[which(obj_plot$TCR_ID == tcr)]
  # --- Highlight clonotype cells using their Seurat cluster colors ---
  cells_by_cluster <- split(
    cells_tcr,
    as.character(obj_plot[[]][cells_tcr, "SCT_snn_res.0.5"])
  )
  # --- Annotate TCR identity, prioritization category, and response ---
  tier_level <- paste0(top_tcrs$Tier[i], "\u2013", top_tcrs$Level[i])
  plot_title <- if (!is.na(top_tcrs$Condition[i]) && top_tcrs$Condition[i] != "") {
    paste0(tcr, " (", tier_level, "): ", as.character(top_tcrs$Condition[i]))
  } else {
    paste0(tcr, " (", tier_level, ")")
  }
  DimPlot(
    obj_plot,
    cells.highlight = cells_by_cluster,
    cols.highlight = unname(cluster_colors[names(cells_by_cluster)]),
    sizes.highlight = 1.5,
    cols = "grey85",
    split.by = "sample_id",
    ncol = length(condition_order)
  ) +
    NoLegend() +
    labs(title = plot_title) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
})
names(tcr_umaps) <- top_tcrs$TCR_ID
# --- Combine UMAPs into the final visualization ---
plots_list[[paste0("IC11_", compartment, "_prioritized_TCRs")]] <- wrap_plots(tcr_umaps, ncol = 3)
plots_list[[paste0("IC11_", compartment, "_prioritized_TCRs")]]
```
